device.name: XKGlow XKChrome Motorcycle LED Controller
device.notes:
BLE motorcycle LED controller from XKGlow. Single custom GATT service with 8 characteristics. Supports RGB color control, mono brightness, LED animation sequences, and multi-zone configuration. The controller auto-discovers zone count and type (color vs mono) from device config on connect.
All UUIDs are in the vendor base 458A7133-xxxx-4E37-A4A4-5D8492586977 with the xxxx suffix encoding the characteristic function.
WRITE TYPE: All writes to ZONE_COMMAND use WRITE_TYPE_NO_RESPONSE (1).
ZONE INDEX: 0-based. Zone 1 = byte 0x00, Zone 2 = byte 0x01, etc. Zone count is discovered from CONTROLLER_CONFIG byte 1 on connect.
COLOR WRITE FORMAT: 6-byte payload: [0x00, zone, 0x04, R, G, B]. Each channel 0-255.
MONO WRITE FORMAT: 6-byte payload: [0x00, zone, 0x04, B, B, B] where all three B bytes are the same brightness value 0-255.
STOP ANIMATION: 4-byte payload: [0x00, zone, 0x05, 0x00].
ANIMATION: Payload partitioned into 19-byte chunks sent at 20ms intervals. Each chunk prefixed with header byte: (total_chunks - 1) << 4 | chunk_index.
INITIALIZATION SEQUENCE (chained reads):
  1. Read CONTROLLER_NAME → triggers read of ZONE_1_NAME
  2. Read ZONE_1_NAME → triggers read of ZONE_2_NAME
  3. Read ZONE_2_NAME → triggers read of SETTING
  4. Read SETTING → triggers read of CONTROLLER_CONFIG
  5. Read CONTROLLER_CONFIG → device ready

SCAN FILTER: Advertised service UUID 458A7133-0000-4E37-A4A4-5D8492586977. Device name from BLE advertisement.
CONFIDENCE: HIGH for all UUIDs and primary command formats. Animation protocol header byte confirmed; per-LED animation data format is not fully decoded (app creates proprietary byte sequences for effects).

credentials.notes: BLE GATT. No auth or pairing. Anything in radio range can connect and command.

factory_reset.effect: No credential state. Power-cycle drops the current connection.

steps.action: Disconnect power for a few seconds and reconnect.
steps.expect: Device advertises again and accepts new connections.

methods.description: Scan for BLE advertisement with service UUID 458A7133-0000-4E37-A4A4-5D8492586977. Connect, discover services, run chained initialization reads to detect zone count and type. Write 6-byte color/mono commands to ZONE_COMMAND for lighting control. Write animation sequences for effects.

steps.action: Scan for BLE advertisements with service UUID 458A7133-0000-4E37-A4A4-5D8492586977.
Read CONTROLLER_NAME, then chain through ZONE_1_NAME, ZONE_2_NAME, SETTING, CONTROLLER_CONFIG.

setup.notes: No provisioning. Scan for the controller service UUID. Connect, discover services, then run the chained initialization read sequence (CONTROLLER_NAME → ZONE_1_NAME → ZONE_2_NAME → SETTING → CONTROLLER_CONFIG) to enumerate zones and controller type.

characteristics.name: Controller Name
characteristics.notes: Human-readable controller name. UTF-8 string. Read triggers the initialization chain: on receive, app reads ZONE_1_NAME.

characteristics.name: Zone 1 Name
characteristics.notes: Human-readable name for zone 1. UTF-8 string. On receive, app reads ZONE_2_NAME (if multi-zone) or SETTING.

characteristics.name: Zone 2 Name
characteristics.notes: Human-readable name for zone 2. UTF-8 string. On receive, app reads SETTING.

characteristics.name: Settings
characteristics.notes: Controller settings. 2+ bytes. Byte 0: brake enabled (0=disabled, non-zero=enabled). Byte 1: auto-off enabled (0=disabled, non-zero=enabled). On receive, app reads CONTROLLER_CONFIG.

characteristics.name: Controller Config
characteristics.notes: Controller configuration. 3+ bytes. Byte 0: controller type code (1=color/RGB, other=mono). Byte 1: total number of zones. Byte 2: firmware revision. On receive, app finalizes device setup and marks it ready.

set_default_brightness.description: Set default brightness configuration (10-byte system command). Observed in setBrightnessDefault: writes [0x00, 0x03, 0x06, 0x06, 0x81, 0x9E, 0x06, 0x00, 0xFF, 0x00].

set_mono_brightness.description: Set mono (single-channel) brightness for a zone. Writes the same value to all three color positions.

set_rgb_color.description: Set solid RGB color for a zone.

write_animation.description:
Write an animation sequence to a zone. Animation payload is partitioned into 19-byte chunks. Each chunk is prefixed with a header byte encoding (total_chunks - 1) << 4 | chunk_index. Chunks are transmitted at 20ms intervals via a timer.
The data stream begins with a 3-byte prefix: [zone, 0x05, 0xFF]. The remaining bytes are the animation LED data.

characteristics.name: Zone Command
characteristics.notes: Command write characteristic. All writes use WRITE_TYPE_NO_RESPONSE (setWriteType(1)). Receives color, mono, animation, and stop commands.

characteristics.name: Time Characteristic
characteristics.notes: Time characteristic. Written to and read from by the app. Exact format not fully decoded; likely sets the controller's internal clock for scheduled operation.

initialization.notes: Read controller name; response triggers chain to ZONE_1_NAME.

services.name: Controller Service
services.notes: Single custom GATT service containing all controller functionality. UUID family uses vendor base 458A7133-xxxx-4E37-A4A4-5D8492586977.
